# Evidence & Provenance Checklist: AI Session Folding

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of everything the fold claims about
evidence — provenance references, count truthfulness, scope and integrity
markings. These are the constitutional risk areas (I, II, IV, VII) for a
feature that projects stored events into a new unit.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the counts that folding must not change enumerated, rather than referred to collectively as "any count the product reports elsewhere"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a requirement stated for the tri-state count itself? The design lives in research only; no FR mandates that a count declare its own completeness. [Gap, Spec §FR-006 vs research §R-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how a session row aggregates *conflicting* member states — three in-scope members and one out-of-scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified which timestamp a session row and a turn display, given Invariant 8 forbids merging Source Time and Receipt Time into one unlabelled value? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are provenance requirements stated for the turn→action reference, or only implied by the data model? [Traceability, Spec §FR-009, data-model §PromptTurn]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec state what a session row reports when a member's scope evaluation is itself unavailable or pending? [Gap, Coverage]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "byte-identical" export output objectively achievable and checkable, given exports may embed generation timestamps? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "reachable in no more steps" quantified with a defined step count, or left to the reviewer's judgement? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "surface the badge on the row" specific enough to distinguish showing a badge from showing a count of badges? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the meaning of "verbatim" defined at the data layer separately from what the display may truncate? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004 vs US2 scenario 3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the spec's counting requirements and research §R-003's tri-state agree, or does the spec still read as though a count is always a number? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, research §R-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the fold's identity rules consistent with the glossary's Agent Session and with `sessionKey`, with no third definition introduced anywhere in the artifact set? [Consistency, plan §Domain contract references]
- [ ] CHK013 Do FR-011 (counts unchanged) and FR-014 (incomplete records say so) stay consistent when a session's record is incomplete — is the engagement-level count then also qualified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-001's "14 rows, not 142" be evaluated without first fixing what counts as a row for a degenerate or unattributed session? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-003's "independent of zoom" bounded by a stated zoom range, or asserted for all possible values? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are success criteria defined for the provenance guarantee itself — that every folded action remains traceable to its source event? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for a session whose members span more than one loaded page, which the plan identifies as the ordinary case rather than an edge case? [Coverage, plan §Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements stated for an agent event whose `session_id` is present but empty, as distinct from absent? [Edge Case, Gap, data-model §Degenerate session]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec address whether a fold may contain events from more than one operator, and what the row then attributes? [Gap, Coverage]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Is the assumption that `agent.user_message` carries the operator prompt for all three adapters validated, or asserted? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the dependency on `events.count` accepting a `session:` condition documented as a contract the feature relies on, rather than as an implementation note? [Dependency, contracts §2]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the consequence stated if a future capture change stops writing `session_id` — does the feature degrade, warn, or fail? [Gap, contracts §3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- CHK002, CHK007 and CHK011 are the items most likely to require a spec edit rather than a reviewer note
